props.reason: Makar is a top-pairing, points-per-game caliber defenseman who quarterbacks the Avalanche power play and logs heavy minutes. Facing a Dallas team at home, he's a near-lock to register at least one point on a given night.

Makar consistently leads Avalanche defensemen in shot attempts and gets heavy point-shot volume on the power play. Plus-money odds on a player who routinely clears this shot total represents strong value.
Lehkonen plays a top-six role with net-front presence and shoots the puck often, especially against divisional foes. His shot volume has been steady, making this a reliable favorite.
Nelson is a top-nine forward who shoots frequently and has good chemistry on Dallas's scoring lines. His consistent shot attempts make the under 1.5 a tough number to clear against him.

Landeskog remains a key power-play and top-line piece for Colorado, generating consistent shot volume when healthy and in the lineup. His physical, shoot-first mentality supports clearing this total regularly.

Toews is Colorado's primary partner to Makar and sees significant power-play time, generating a steady diet of assists. Facing Dallas at home, his offensive involvement should continue trending positively.
Protas has emerged as a key power-play contributor and shoots frequently in Washington's top-six mix. Facing a Montreal team on the road, his shot attempts have remained consistent night to night.

Tuch is a high-volume shooter who often leads Montreal forwards in shot attempts, especially in favorable offensive matchups. The plus-money price here provides good value given his typical shot share.
